channels.name: std.session.status
channels.description: Connection state of the source (std::ConnectionStatus).

channels.name: std.input.throttle
channels.description: Throttle pedal: 0 = released, 1 = fully pressed.

channels.name: std.input.brake
channels.description: Brake pedal: 0 = released, 1 = fully pressed.

channels.name: std.input.clutch
channels.description: Clutch pedal: 0 = released, 1 = fully pressed (like throttle and brake).

channels.name: std.input.steering
channels.description: Steering wheel angle normalised to full lock: +1 = fully turned left (counter-clockwise seen by the driver), -1 = fully right.

channels.name: std.input.handbrake
channels.description: Handbrake lever: 0 = released, 1 = fully pulled.

channels.name: std.vehicle.speed
channels.description: Speed over ground, always >= 0.

channels.name: std.vehicle.velocity.lon
channels.description: Velocity along the vehicle's longitudinal axis, + = forward.

channels.name: std.vehicle.velocity.lat
channels.description: Velocity along the vehicle's lateral axis, + = left.

channels.name: std.vehicle.velocity.vert
channels.description: Velocity along the vehicle's vertical axis, + = up.

channels.name: std.vehicle.accel.lon
channels.description: Acceleration along the longitudinal axis, + = forward.

channels.name: std.vehicle.accel.lat
channels.description: Acceleration along the lateral axis, + = left (a left turn reads positive).

channels.name: std.vehicle.accel.vert
channels.description: Acceleration along the vertical axis, + = up, gravity removed (0 at rest).

channels.name: std.vehicle.yaw_rate
channels.description: Rotation about the vertical axis, + = counter-clockwise seen from above (turning left).

channels.name: std.vehicle.pitch_rate
channels.description: Rotation about the lateral axis, + = nose down.

channels.name: std.vehicle.roll_rate
channels.description: Rotation about the longitudinal axis, + = right side down.

channels.name: std.vehicle.orientation.pitch
channels.description: Pitch angle relative to the horizontal plane, + = nose down.

channels.name: std.vehicle.orientation.roll
channels.description: Roll angle relative to the horizontal plane, + = right side down.

channels.name: std.vehicle.pit_limiter
channels.description: 1 = pit limiter is engaged.

channels.name: std.vehicle.boost_active
channels.description: 1 = a push-to-pass, boost or overtake system is delivering extra power now.

channels.name: std.assist.abs_active
channels.description: 1 = ABS is reducing brake pressure on at least one wheel now (not: ABS is switched on).

channels.name: std.assist.tc_active
channels.description: 1 = traction control is cutting torque now (not: TC is switched on).

channels.name: std.engine.rpm
channels.description: Crankshaft speed.

channels.name: std.engine.max_rpm
channels.description: Rev limit of the current car.

channels.name: std.engine.throttle
channels.description: Throttle plate opening as applied by the engine: 0 = closed, 1 = fully open (differs from input.throttle with electronic throttle or traction control).

channels.name: std.engine.torque
channels.description: Torque at the crankshaft, + = driving.

channels.name: std.engine.manifold_pressure
channels.description: Absolute intake manifold pressure. Predates the two-source rule (one source at 1.0).

channels.name: std.engine.ignition
channels.description: 1 = ignition is on.

channels.name: std.engine.starter
channels.description: 1 = starter motor is engaged.

channels.name: std.engine.rev_limiter
channels.description: 1 = the rev limiter is cutting now.

channels.name: std.drivetrain.gear
channels.description: Selected gear: -1 = reverse, 0 = neutral, 1.. = forward gears.

channels.name: std.steering.torque
channels.description: Torque on the steering wheel, + = torque that turns the wheel left.

channels.name: std.aero.drs
channels.description: 1 = DRS (or an equivalent drag-reduction flap) is open.

channels.name: std.hybrid.deploy
channels.description: Hybrid or KERS deployment: 0 = none, 1 = maximum.

arrays.name: std.suspension.deflection
arrays.description: Change of the suspension travel from the sim's reference position, + = compression; not normalised. Ride height is in ride_height.

arrays.name: std.suspension.velocity
arrays.description: Rate of change of deflection, same sign: + = compressing.

arrays.name: std.suspension.ride_height
arrays.description: Height of the chassis above the ground at the wheel.

arrays.name: std.wheel.speed
arrays.description: Angular speed of the wheel, + = rolling forward.

arrays.name: std.wheel.load
arrays.description: Vertical force on the tyre contact patch, >= 0.

arrays.name: std.wheel.slip_ratio
arrays.description: (omega*r - v) / |v| of the tyre: 0 = free rolling, -1 = locked, > 0 = wheelspin. Predates the two-source rule.

arrays.name: std.wheel.slip_angle
arrays.description: Angle of the contact-patch velocity relative to the wheel heading, + = patch moving to the left of the heading. Predates the two-source rule.

arrays.name: std.wheel.force.lat
arrays.description: Lateral force on the tyre from the road in the wheel's axes, + = left.

arrays.name: std.wheel.force.lon
arrays.description: Longitudinal force on the tyre from the road in the wheel's axes, + = forward (traction).

arrays.name: std.tyre.temp.inner
arrays.description: Tread temperature on the side toward the car's centre line, for both sides of the car.

arrays.name: std.tyre.temp.middle
arrays.description: Tread temperature in the middle of the tread.

arrays.name: std.tyre.temp.outer
arrays.description: Tread temperature on the side away from the car's centre line, for both sides of the car.

arrays.name: std.tyre.pressure
arrays.description: Tyre pressure (absolute or gauge as delivered by the source).

arrays.name: std.brake.temp
arrays.description: Brake disc temperature per wheel; a source with a single value broadcasts it to every wheel.

arrays.name: std.wheel.contact
arrays.description: 1 = the tyre touches the ground, 0 = airborne.

arrays.name: std.wheel.surface_speed
arrays.description: Linear speed of the tread relative to the wheel centre (omega*r), + = rolling forward, same sign as wheel.speed.

arrays.name: std.suspension.third
arrays.description: Travel of the third (heave) element of the axle, + = compression.

Surface.doc: Values of std.wheel.surface[*]. Append-only; 12..15 are reserved for additions.
